SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nodisp, MIN(o.order_ts_utc), MAX(o.order_ts_utc),
 SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_lines
FROM fact_web_order o GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wo AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, s.store_id AS sale_store, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN wo w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
rets AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, rs.store_id AS ret_store, -r.refund_net AS amt, s.store_id AS sale_store
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN wo w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'sales' k, d.fiscal_period, fulfilment_type, sale_store AS st, COUNT(*) n, SUM(amt) amt

UNION ALL

WITH wo AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.fulfilment_type, 900 AS booked_store, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN wo w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, w.fulfilment_type, rs.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN wo w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' AND booked_store=900 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) cc_900,
  SUM(CASE WHEN booked_store=900 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) web_900,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' AND booked_store=900 THEN amt ELSE 0 END)/SUM(CASE WHEN booked_store=900 THEN amt ELSE 0 END),2) share_900,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN amt ELSE 0 END) cc_all,
  SUM(amt) web_all,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN amt ELSE 0 END)/SUM(amt),2) share_all,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' AND amt>0 THEN amt ELSE 0 END)/SUM(CASE WHEN amt>0 THEN amt ELSE 0 END),2) share_gross_of_returns,
  (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d2.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND d2.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) rpt_900
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

),

  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN wo w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN amt ELSE 0 END)/SUM(amt),1) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2
